name: Yin Release Adept: Yin Release – Chains of Causality

system.description:
You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to bind a vision of the future to your foe, making it their truth, their reality. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, each time they make a Weapon attack or cast a jutsu, they suffer a -1 penalty to their AC for attacks you make against them, as each of these activities have been foreseen and it brings you closer to the destined strike you know to be true.

Beginning at 11th level, if your attack result would be 10 or higher than the AC of a Yin Sealed target, you treat that attack as a Critical hit.
